selected_evidence.requirement: Cron job runs inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15 and retains output in /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline confirmed binary and cron service present; crontab entry '15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1' installed for root and verified via crontab -l; manual execution via sudo shell confirmed the binary writes 'inventory maintenance completed at ...' into /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log using the same redirect path cron will use.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (b185f188-42be-40d1-84ea-f7c9a76f5c8d), confirmed cron active, crontab entry present, and log content present.
Issued 'sudo -n reboot' backgrounded so the exec call returned 'reboot acknowledged and issued' before the node disconnected.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Node was unreachable (connection refused) immediately after reboot, then came back with a new boot_id (794a4672-88bc-474c-8003-21b11e9c6af5), proving an actual restart occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: post-restart recovery of required services and data
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, cron service is enabled and active, root crontab still contains the 02:15 inventory-maintenance entry, /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log content persisted, and the binary file is unchanged and present.

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== boot id baseline =="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo "== binary check =="
ls -l /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance || echo "MISSING_BINARY"
echo "== cron service =="
systemctl is-active cron || systemctl is-active crond || echo "NO_CRON_SVC"
which crontab || echo "NO_CRONTAB_BIN"
commands.stdout:
== boot id baseline ==
b185f188-42be-40d1-84ea-f7c9a76f5c8d
== binary check ==
-rwxr-xr-x 1 root root 92 Jun 15 00:26 /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
== cron service ==
active
/usr/bin/crontab

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== install cron job =="
CRON_LINE='15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1'
( sudo -n crontab -l -u root 2>/dev/null | grep -v inventory-maintenance || true; echo "$CRON_LINE" ) | sudo -n crontab -u root -
echo "== verify installed =="
sudo -n crontab -l -u root
echo "== ensure log file exists with correct perms =="
sudo -n touch /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
sudo -n chmod 644 /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
ls -l /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
echo "== manual run to confirm binary + log path work =="
sudo -n /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1
tail -n 20 /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
echo "== cron service enabled/active =="
systemctl is-enabled cron
systemctl is-active cron
